Subject: Heating Repair Request

Hi [Landlord's Name],

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to check in about the heating in my apartment, which has been cold for several days now. Would it be possible to have it repaired this week?

Please let me know if there’s anything I need to do to help schedule the repair.

Thank you!
